description: Defines thread-safe queue classes (QueueType and CategoryQueueType) with synchronization, state management, and category-based queuing for the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: QueueType
classes.description: A thread-safe queue template class with state management, supporting add, remove, extract, enable, disable, and flush operations.

classes.name: CategoryQueueType
classes.description: A category-based, thread-safe queue template class with dynamic threshold support, multiple priority categories, and in-process tracking.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the queue if present.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Adds an entry to the queue if not disabled.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts an entry into the queue with optional waiting, supporting queue capacity and priority categories.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Retrieves and removes an entry from the queue, with optional waiting.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the queue, preventing further operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all entries in the queue; only valid when disabled.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if an entry exists in the queue.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Applies a provided action to each entry in the queue.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the queue.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: IsFull
methods.description: Checks if the queue has reached its maximum capacity.
